integrity.verification: all-size constructive and incidence proofs plus finite standalone checks

scientific_limitations: Uniform single-site closed-neighborhood minority update with tie retention; exactly one leaf on an odd clique; does not extend automatically to other update rules or graph families.
There are two stationary classes, not a unique global stationary law; all spectral statements are class-conditional.
Absorption-time distributions and basin probabilities have not been derived.
The originality comparison is a qualified best-knowledge literature comparison; independent historical priority certification is absent.
title: One pendant leaf splits the stochastic-minority attractor of an odd clique without changing its population
